summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the new Booking rules + Bot customization iteration. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests PASSED covering (a) auth regression (admin+demo login, bad creds, /api/me, /admin/users list + PUT), (b) PUT /me/profile persistence of all 11 new fields (business_hours, meeting_duration, business_timezone, blocked_slots, recurring_blocks, zoom_meeting_link, bot_name, bot_greeting, bot_tone, bot_tagline, logo_url) with round-trip GET /me verification, (c) GET /api/booking/available-slots — respects weekend disabled, business hours 09-17 UTC, one-off block on 2026-08-11 14-16, weekly Friday 15-23:59 recurring block, (d) POST /api/booking/confirm rule enforcement: 400 'closed' on Saturday, 400 'hours' before 09:00, 400 'blocked' inside carved window, 200 accept on valid Tue 10:00 with zoom_link, google_calendar_url (starts with google.com/calendar/render), start_iso/end_iso with duration=30 min, (e) POST /me/logo accepts PNG (returns logo_url, GET /me reflects it), DELETE /me/logo clears it, bad extension .exe rejected 400, (f) /api/chat/stream returns 200 SSE (endpoint healthy). Frontend: All 5 tabs render (tab-knowledge/branding/bot/booking/matrix). Bot tab: bot-name-input, bot-tagline-input, bot-greeting-input all save via onBlur → PUT /me/profile succeeds; bot-tone-{friendly,professional,casual,luxury} clickable and persists; logo-upload-input accepts PNG and current-logo displays; widget-logo replaces sparkles badge in sandbox; logo-remove-btn clears it. Widget header shows 'Aria' as name and 'Your concierge' as tagline and 'Hey, how can I help?' as first message. Booking tab: zoom-link-input, duration-select, timezone-input, day-toggle-{mon..sun}, day-start/end-{mon..sun}, block-{date,start,end,note}+add-block-btn (row added with remove-block-0), rec-{day,start,end}+add-rec-btn (row added with remove-rec-0), slot-preview-grid all present and functional. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:940-951 uses start_utc.weekday() and business hours keyed by day, but business_timezone is not applied when validating hours — 09:00 America/New_York would still be checked against 09:00 UTC. Booking rules will be off by whatever the tenant's real TZ offset is. Recommend converting start_utc to tenant timezone before day_key/open_at/close_at computation, otherwise the 'business hours' setting is effectively UTC-only regardless of business_timezone.

server.py:258-289 _compute_available_slots has the same UTC-only bug: iterates day boundaries in UTC, so a tenant in NY sees Mon slots at 09:00 UTC (04:00 local) instead of 09:00 local. Same fix — pin to business_timezone.

server.py:634-637 DELETE /me/logo does $unset only; storage object is left orphaned in Emergent Object Storage. Consider deleting the old object (or at least logging path for GC) to avoid unbounded logo bloat.
server.py:617-632 upload_logo does not delete the previous logo_url object before overwriting — every re-upload leaks one blob.
Dashboard.jsx has grown to 715 lines; BookingRulesPanel + BotCustomizationPanel could be split into their own files to keep files under the 700-line guideline.

server.py:934 _parse_slot_datetime fallback returns datetime.now+1day at 15:00 when parse fails, silently rewriting the requested slot — bookings can succeed for an unintended time. Better to raise 400 'Invalid slot' when parse fails.

server.py:1032 booking/confirm response returns 200 even if send_email/send_sms fail (they return False and are logged only). That is fine, but the API contract should probably surface delivery status in response so the client widget can show 'confirmed, but email queued'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present and functional across Bot + Booking tabs and Widget)

seed_data_creation: During tests, demo tenant profile was populated with business_hours, blocked_slots [2026-08-11 14:00-16:00], recurring_blocks [friday 15:00-23:59], meeting_duration=30, timezone=America/New_York, zoom_meeting_link, bot_name=Aria, bot_tagline=Your concierge, bot_greeting='Hey, how can I help?', bot_tone=friendly. One accepted booking created for 2026-08-11T10:00Z (Tuesday, valid). Logo uploaded then removed; final state has no logo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rerun: pytest backend/tests/test_iteration10_booking_bot.py -v -n 0. Demo tenant is already seeded with booking rules from this run; if you need to reset, PUT /me/profile with empty arrays. Note the tests assume DEFAULT_BUSINESS_HOURS mon-fri 09:00-17:00 UTC (weekend disabled) — do not toggle those before re-running or the closed-day/outside-hours assertions will change.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues to root-cause. Only architectural observation: business_timezone field exists but is never consulted server-side; booking availability + validation operate purely in UTC. This is a latent correctness bug for any tenant not in UTC and should be prioritized by the main agent.
